constants.body_fat_source: Deurenberg Equation (1991), using BMI and age = 22 years
constants.density_formula: BODY_DENSITY = 4.950 / (BODY_FAT_FRACTION + 4.500), Siri 1956, UCRL-3349 eq. (10); M_mesh = BODY_DENSITY x (V_mesh - V_LUNG)
